Hi Alex —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from our discovery call and suggested next steps so we can get the Dedicated sizing session scheduled: 

What we heard:
- Use case: patient triage + clinical notes summarization across the web portal and mobile app.
- Expected steady-state traffic: ~150-200 QPS for embeddings+chat blend during peak windows (subject to your validation).
- Latency target: P95 text-gen latency < 250ms for short prompts, < 500ms for multi-turn flows.
- Data controls: VPC private deployment, SOC2 compliance, KMS for keys.

Next steps proposed:
1) Technical sizing call (we call this a Dedicated capacity sizing call) to align on model variant, peak concurrency, batching, and network topology. Please include an infra/SRE and an ML engineer from your side.
2) If you can, fill in the attached capacity_sizing_template.xlsx with your expected request patterns ahead of the call — it speeds up the session.
3) Proposed times: Tue 2026-10-06 10:00 AM PT or Wed 2026-10-07 9:00 AM PT. Two slots to accommodate your team.

I've attached the sizing template and a short checklist of items we'll walk through. Rachel will be on the call as well. If either of the proposed slots work, I’ll send a calendar invite with Zoom and an agenda.

Attachments: capacity_sizing_template.xlsx (XLSX, 48KB)

Best,
Marissa Cole

Marissa —

Appreciate the recap. The team had a quick sync after our call and the proposed times look good in general. A few clarifications from our side so you can tailor the sizing session: 

- Traffic profile: the 150-200 QPS is accurate for peak daytime hours. We also have an expected spike pattern during intake windows (roughly +40% for ~15 minutes).
- Workload mix: ~60% embeddings for search/indexing, ~40% text-gen/chat for triage flows. Token sizes average 300 tokens for chat, embeddings requests are batched in groups up to 64.
- Latency: P95 target of 300ms for the chat endpoints is acceptable; embeddings can tolerate higher latency but we want steady throughput.

Attendees I’ll confirm: myself (platform lead), Priya Natarajan (ML infra) and our SRE lead (I’ll loop them once I confirm their calendars). Procurement is CC'd to make sure any pre-call paperwork is noted.

Tue 10/6 10:00 AM PT should work for us, pending final confirmation from SRE. If you can hold that slot tentatively, we’ll lock it by EOD tomorrow. I’ll try to pre-fill the sizing template with the traffic histogram we have.

Thanks —
